text:
Beigehendes Billet habe ich heute früh erhalten — Es war
aus Versehen in mein altes Logis liegen geblieben -
Herr Homuth hat desfals so eben wieder zu mich
geschickt und läst sehr bitten, daß diese Post bald
berichtiget wird damit er den Boten sogleich
den Eingang der 166 Rthl 16 g. mit anzeigen Kan¬
Cabanis reiſet ſo eben mit der Poſt nach Hus
sinietz ab - ich verspreche mir von dieſer Seite
den ſchnelleſten und glücklichſte Erfolg.
Von Berlin oder Franckfurth habe ich heute keine
Sylbe erhalten.
Breslau d 6ten April
1804.
v Triebenfeld

translation.en: The enclosed note I received this morning early — It had been left lying, by an oversight, in my old lodging - Herr Homuth has on that account just now sent to me again, and begs most earnestly that this item be settled soon, so that he may at once notify the messenger of the receipt of the 166 Rthl 16 g. Cabanis is departing this very moment by the post for Hussinietz - I promise myself from this quarter the swiftest and happiest success. From Berlin or Franckfurth I have received not a syllable today. Breslau, the 6th of April 1804. v Triebenfeld

text_english: The enclosed note I received this morning early — It had been left lying, by an oversight, in my old lodging - Herr Homuth has on that account just now sent to me again, and begs most earnestly that this item be settled soon, so that he may at once notify the messenger of the receipt of the 166 Rthl 16 g. Cabanis is departing this very moment by the post for Hussinietz - I promise myself from this quarter the swiftest and happiest success. From Berlin or Franckfurth I have received not a syllable today. Breslau, the 6th of April 1804. v Triebenfeld
summary_en: Forwards an enclosed note only received that morning, having been left behind through an oversight at his former lodging. Herr Homuth has sent again and presses urgently for early settlement of the item, so that he can confirm to the messenger receipt of the 166 Rthl 16 g. Reports that Cabanis is leaving by post that moment for Hussinietz, from which quarter he expects swift success, and that nothing has come from Berlin or Franckfurth.
summary_de: Übersendung eines erst am Morgen erhaltenen Zettels, der versehentlich in Triebenfelds alter Wohnung liegengeblieben war; Herr Homuth habe deshalb erneut nachgefragt und bitte dringend um baldige Berichtigung der 166 Rthl 16 g, damit er dem Boten den Empfang anzeigen könne. Cabanis reise eben mit der Post nach Hussinietz ab, wovon Triebenfeld schnellsten und glücklichsten Erfolg erwartet. Aus Berlin und Franckfurth sei an diesem Tage keine Nachricht eingegangen.
